notes: Owner's Mac reported LOCAL_ARCHIVE_SHA_OK and scp runtime.tar.gz 100% 779KB. Remote script progressed past test -f and clean target checks then stopped at HASH_TOOL_UNAVAILABLE. No checksum comparison completed remotely; no archive extraction or public bootstrap installation.
deployment_blocker: Transfer complete; SSH confirms archive exists and intended runtime targets are clean, but server-held file SHA-256 remains UNVERIFIED because sha256sum/openssl are not on the SSH PATH. Read back archive to Mac for full hash+byte comparison before extraction.

provisioning.note: Owner explicitly confirmed mcp-kmhn.landco.co.jp and SSL setup. Treat as configured, not as proof of publicly reachable TLS or a deployed MCP endpoint.
provisioning.full_path_confidentiality: Exact absolute account path is kept out of this public repository; use local SSH/private deployment variable.

tls_verification.limitation: This validates TLS hostname and chain from one runner, NOT deployed PHP runtime or MCP protocol.

public_root_type: FTP account full path is the web document root; owner-confirmed, not independently inspected over SSH
private_runtime_layout: An SSH-accessible directory OUTSIDE the FTP root and any other HTTP document root; do not assume an FTP-root sibling is private
layout_strategy: Only bootstrap index.php and .htaccess under FTP root/kmhn. Place original universal/server tree outside HTTP roots and require its absolute entrypoint from bootstrap.

ftp_root.scope: account-local only; never commit absolute full path

ssh_validation.observed: Successful cd to previously supplied full web root; KMHN_OK; PRIVATE_PARENT_WRITABLE
ssh_validation.important_limit: Test -w on parent does not imply private candidate directory exists, nor Web PHP access to files outside web, nor effective PHP 8.5.

php_web_private_read_validation.source: Owner-supplied authenticated Lolipop SSH terminal output from one-shot Web PHP canary
php_web_private_read_validation.probe_files_cleanup: Expected from EXIT trap; not separately verified on host

pre_deployment_inventory.public_probe_files: none matched kmhn_private_probe_*.php at kmhn maxdepth1
pre_deployment_inventory.private_marker_files: none matched .kmhn-read-* in private candidate maxdepth1
pre_deployment_inventory.scope_limit: Only specified names/globs were checked; other files and alternate vhost exposure were not inventoried; no server artifact installed.

transfer_evidence.source: Owner Mac SCP output plus authenticated Lolipop SSH fail-closed verification, 2026-10-19
transfer_evidence.remote_tool_detection: Neither sha256sum nor openssl was available on the SSH PATH
transfer_evidence.secure_fallback: SCP server archive back to the Owner Mac and verify with shasum -a 256 and cmp against the locally authenticated archive. No need for server-side hash tools.
transfer_evidence.remote_transfer_warning: The SCP client printed SSH post-quantum KEX and RSA host-key update proof warnings. Confirm server identity via official host-key guidance; do not disable host-key verification.
